name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success Manager | Onboarding, Adoption, Retention & Expansion for B2B SaaS
summary: Customer success and account management professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and MarTech, owning books of business from post-sale onboarding through adoption, retention, and expansion. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%) by reading utilization data and intervening before adoption gaps became churn. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix while leading a team of 8 to 20 specialists, hitting 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets. As a founder, builds the onboarding workflows, health tracking, and automation a scaling CS team runs on, and brings working fluency in home-services and trade businesses.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, including home-services trade businesses, running discovery and onboarding to define goals, workflows, and success criteria.
Lead end-to-end onboarding onto new technology stacks, translating business requirements into configurations and delivering hands-on training that drives adoption.
Design and deploy automated onboarding workflows, lifecycle sequences, and CRM architectures (20+ GoHighLevel workflows) that activate, nurture, and retain customers at scale.
Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts, recommending and scoping complementary services tied to each client's objectives.
Report on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, tracking account health and outcomes in GA4, CRM analytics, and custom dashboards.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts as strategic lead, translating performance data into recommendations and running quarterly business reviews.
Built reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and resolved client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Customer Success & Retention - Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Owned a book of 15-20 B2B reseller partners (contracts ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to flag underused accounts and adoption gaps early, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to prove product value to their own customers.
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Guided customers through complex technical setup of reputation and marketing automation tools.
Fed structured, high-priority customer feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end, covering execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication, including home-services clients.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between client-facing and delivery teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded 25+ clients per month to their first sale (Wix counted an onboarding as won only once the client's first sale was on the books), holding 110% of implementation targets and 120% of sales targets.
Led client launches as primary strategic contact, delivering on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Led and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later 8), overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value portfolio.
Built team processes, hiring, onboarding, and training for a brand-new Wix vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team so sales expectations carried into delivery.
Advised clients on CRM adoption and guided onboarding alongside implementation teams, resolving workflow and technical issues during setup.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps, sustained while quota roughly doubled.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for an SMB loyalty and marketing automation platform, building the consultative approach to retention and adoption that carried into later SaaS roles.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
